lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Semi-regular grid of high-intensity circular spots arranged in at least five identifiable horizontal rows across the mid-lateral flank, with higher spot density observed in the anterior region near the branchial slits.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated luminance intersect with horizontal spot rows to form a grid-like pattern of anchor nodes, most visible in the central flank region.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Multiple longitudinal dermal carinae visible as horizontal linear features with a sharp light-to-shadow gradient, running parallel to the body axis along the upper half of the visible flank.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Partial visualization of the first dorsal fin at the upper-left margin showing a scattered distribution of low-count, high-luminance spots within its visible boundary.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of multiple small, yellow-colored auxiliary bio-signatures (likely teleost fish) clustered near the pectoral fin and lower branchial region.
